note: Two shaded gravel sites about 280 m apart on Right Branch Young Womans Creek Road, which the booking pages call streamside: 026 Plantation Hole, 2.9 miles up the road, and 027 Laurelly Fork, 3.1 miles. The agency's route leaves PA 120 at North Bend on Main Street and continues straight onto Right Branch Young Womans Creek Road after 0.7 mile. Campers must bring a self-contained toilet. The agency cautions that it is reached by remote dirt or gravel forest roads that may not suit low-clearance vehicles or large RVs. No table or water. Pack out trash. --Claude
summary: Both site pages re-read: 026 Plantation Hole and 027 Laurelly Fork still listed, Drive-In, Trailer Site category, max vehicle 25 ft, gravel; count 2, 25 ft and pull_through (026 only) confirmed, a sites note added (027 parallel, equipment length 15).
